what: Built claude-mem bundles carrying the session-start shared-store read fix.
why_this_branch: The upstream PR branch stays SOURCE-ONLY so thedotmack/claude-mem#4112 remains a clean, reviewable diff. Built bundles live here instead. This branch is fork-only and must NEVER be proposed upstream.

verify.note: A FIXED bundle CALLS the route; a stock 13.26.0 bundle only DEFINES contextObservations(). The dot is the whole discriminator -- grep for the definition and a stock bundle reads as fixed.

not_byte_reproducible: worker-service.cjs differs between builds of the SAME source ref, so a verifier cannot rebuild and compare hashes. Integrity is the sha256 pinned in claude-code-policy, not a rebuild.
version_guard: These bundles are built from 13.26.0 ONLY. Installing them into a different plugin version would downgrade that bundle's unrelated code. The converge MUST match upstream_version against the target bundle's version and refuse otherwise.
